items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore suffered a shoulder injury (AC joint sprain) Thursday night vs Lions, ruled OUT for the game after landing hard; doctors do not consider it serious, day-to-day with a chance but not a lock to play next week vs Chargers.
items.why: Landed hard on shoulder attempting diving catch; X-rays, stinger/AC sprain confirmed by sources.
items.implication: Missed rest of TNF; monitor for Week 3 availability. Immediate WR depth hit for BUF.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for other Bills WRs in remaining game and potentially Week 3.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wednesday practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024 on similar); Grade 1 strain, DNP Thursday, status in jeopardy for Sunday vs CIN per MRI/tests. Ran 37/42 routes Week 1.
items.why: Hammy pull during practice; team doctors say not serious but jeopardy for Week 2; extensive soft-tissue history.
items.implication: High risk of missing vs Bengals; monitor Friday practice. Fantasy sit if OUT.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Xavier Hutchinson, Kayshon Boutte, Jaylin Noel, Dalton Schultz.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go'; unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but timing ideal with AJ Brown on IR and strong upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF etc before bye).
items.why: Returning healthy; Pats desperate for explosives post-Brown IR; favorable schedule stretch.
items.implication: Potential timeshare expansion or lead role upside; monitor snaps/carries.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/routes if he outplays Stevenson; handcuff value high.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week's knee surgery; has yet to practice since procedure.
items.why: Meniscus surgery pre-Week 1; no practice yet this week.
items.implication: Unlikely for Week 2 vs LAC; Michael Mayer primary beneficiary as streamer.
items.opportunity: Full TE snaps/routes to Michael Mayer.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs from Week 1), making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury sustained Week 1; consecutive DNPs.
items.implication: Expect OUT or limited; downgrade Week 2 projections heavily.
items.opportunity: Boost to Quentin Johnston, Tre Harris (waiver), others in LAC WR room.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday (second straight); Ja'Kobi Lane already IR (wrist). If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, LaJohntay Wester, etc.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated; consecutive missed practices ahead of vs Saints.
items.implication: High OUT risk Week 2; Bateman becomes primary target.
items.opportunity: Elevated role/snaps for Rashod Bateman and secondary WRs.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller. Also streaming options and One Injury Away list.
items.why: Direct injury fallout mapping for available players.
items.implication: Prioritize these adds for role expansion.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: 99 Utilization Score Week 1 (tied Bijan lead); 19% target share recent, 25+ touches in 3/4 last games. Overreaction to injury scare.
items.why: Elite util under Kubiak; volume locked.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q Week 1 (74% snaps), 24% target share (tied lead, 2nd-highest career); Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite early usage + soft matchup; massive season range of outcomes including RB1 overall.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry share locked in KC offense.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: career-high 26% target share Week 1, 8 more routes than Gainwell, all RB RZ touches; CLE soft vs run.
items.why: Passing-game dominance + RZ monopoly in new backfield.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career games with Wentz. CHI soft vs WRs.
DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% targets, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) Week 1; TEN allowed high catch rate/YPR, 6th-most PPG to WRs recently.
items.opportunity: Deep targets + share in PHI offense.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE vs SEA: only 8% target share Week 1 (5th on team), zero RZ; SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs recently.
Dalton Kincaid LOVE vs DET: 69% routes (highest any game last year), 77% snaps (highest since 2024 W9); DET allowed 27 pts to TEs Week 1. Efficiency + health signal breakout.
items.why: Expanded role post-health; elite per-target history.
items.implication: TE1 upside this week and ROS.
